code.description: The status code, which should be an enum value of [google.rpc.Code][google.rpc.Code].

message.description: A developer-facing error message, which should be in English. Any user-facing error message should be localized and sent in the [google.rpc.Status.details][google.rpc.Status.details] field, or localized by the client.

details.description: A list of messages that carry the error details. There is no limit on the number of messages.

type.description: A URL that acts as a globally unique identifier for the type of the serialized message. For example: `type.googleapis.com/google.rpc.ErrorInfo`.

value.description: The Protobuf message, serialized as bytes and base64-encoded. The specific message type is identified by the `type` field.

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: Deserialized error detail payload. The 'type' field indicates the schema. This field is for easier debugging and should not be relied upon for application logic.

connect.error_details.Any.description: Contains an arbitrary serialized message along with a @type that describes the type of the serialized message, with an additional debug field for ConnectRPC error details.

encoding.title: encoding
encoding.description: Define which encoding or 'Message-Codec' to use

google.protobuf.Timestamp.description: A point in time in RFC 3339 format, with up to nanosecond precision. Output uses UTC (`Z`); input may use an offset from UTC.

yunheshiguang.adb.v1.AdbRuntimeState.title: AdbRuntimeState
yunheshiguang.adb.v1.AdbRuntimeState.description: Contains one consistent probe of the selected host-wide ADB runtime.

yunheshiguang.adb.v1.AdbServerState.title: AdbServerState
yunheshiguang.adb.v1.AdbServerState.description: Describes whether the selected ADB runtime answered its probe.

yunheshiguang.adb.v1.AdbTransportKind.title: AdbTransportKind
yunheshiguang.adb.v1.AdbTransportKind.description: Describes how an ADB target is connected to the host.

yunheshiguang.api.v1.ApiAuthenticatorInf.title: ApiAuthenticatorInfo
yunheshiguang.api.v1.ApiAuthenticatorInf.description:
One way the gateway recognizes a caller, such as the core's token store or
 an enterprise identity service an extension provides.

yunheshiguang.api.v1.ApiEvent.title: ApiEvent
yunheshiguang.api.v1.ApiEvent.description:
One message on the `/v1/events` WebSocket: a workspace event and its JSON
 payload, the same pair the desktop windows receive.

yunheshiguang.api.v1.ApiGatewayConfig.title: ApiGatewayConfig
yunheshiguang.api.v1.ApiGatewayConfig.description:
The local HTTP and WebSocket API. It listens on the loopback interface only
 and is off until the operator turns it on.

secret.title: secret
secret.description: The new token's secret, set only by `create_api_token`. It is not stored.

yunheshiguang.api.v1.ApiGatewayResult.title: ApiGatewayResult
yunheshiguang.api.v1.ApiGatewayResult.description: Whether a gateway change was made, and the gateway afterwards.

address.title: address
address.description: The base URL while the gateway listens, for example `http://127.0.0.1:47831`.

yunheshiguang.api.v1.ApiToken.title: ApiToken
yunheshiguang.api.v1.ApiToken.description:
A token the core issued. The secret itself is shown once, when the token is
 created; only a digest is kept.

configurable.title: configurable
configurable.description:
The settings page configures its endpoint, model, and key. Contributed
 providers read their own configuration.

yunheshiguang.assistant.v1.AssistantProv.title: AssistantProviderInfo
yunheshiguang.assistant.v1.AssistantProv.description:
One way to reach a language model: the core's OpenAI-compatible endpoint, or
 a provider an extension contributes.

providerId.title: provider_id
providerId.description: The provider that drafts; empty means the first ready one.

baseUrl.title: base_url
baseUrl.description: Settings of the core's OpenAI-compatible provider.

apiKeySet.title: api_key_set
apiKeySet.description: Whether a key is stored. The key itself never leaves the backend.

providers.title: providers
providers.description: Contributed providers first, then the core's.

yunheshiguang.assistant.v1.DraftFlowEven.title: DraftFlowEvent
yunheshiguang.assistant.v1.DraftFlowEven.description: Part of the answer as the model writes it, then the finished draft.

prompt.title: prompt
prompt.description: What the flow should do, in the operator's words.

stepId.title: step_id
stepId.description: The step it concerns; empty for the draft as a whole.

yunheshiguang.assistant.v1.DraftIssue.title: DraftIssue
yunheshiguang.assistant.v1.DraftIssue.description: Something in a draft that needs attention before the flow can run.

yunheshiguang.assistant.v1.DraftScriptEv.title: DraftScriptEvent
yunheshiguang.assistant.v1.DraftScriptEv.description: Part of the answer as the model writes it, then the finished draft.

currentBody.title: current_body
currentBody.description: The script being edited, for requests such as "also print the battery".

yunheshiguang.assistant.v1.FlowDraft.title: FlowDraft
yunheshiguang.assistant.v1.FlowDraft.description:
A flow the model proposed. It is never saved or run automatically: the
 operator reviews it in the editor first.

explanation.title: explanation
explanation.description: What the script does, in the model's words.

yunheshiguang.assistant.v1.StructuredOut.title: StructuredOutput
yunheshiguang.assistant.v1.StructuredOut.description: How the core asks an OpenAI-compatible endpoint for structured output.

settings.title: settings
settings.description: `api_key_set` is ignored; use `api_key` to change the key.

apiKey.title: api_key
apiKey.description:
A new key. Absent keeps the stored key while `settings.base_url` stays on
 the same origin; empty removes it.

runId.title: run_id
runId.description: The run that changed; empty when a schedule changed.

yunheshiguang.automation.v1.AutomationCh.title: AutomationChanged
yunheshiguang.automation.v1.AutomationCh.description:
Payload of the `workspace:automation-changed` event, sent whenever a run
 progresses or a schedule changes.

yunheshiguang.automation.v1.Flow.title: Flow
yunheshiguang.automation.v1.Flow.description:
A flow: batch actions run in order on the same devices. Each flow is one
 document in the `automation-flows` collection; the frontend writes it and
 the backend runs it.

yunheshiguang.automation.v1.FlowEntry.title: FlowEntry
yunheshiguang.automation.v1.FlowEntry.description: A stored flow and its document id, as the local API lists them.

id.title: id
id.description: Time-ordered, so sorting by id sorts by start time.

actor.title: actor
actor.description: What started the run: a window label, `schedule:<name>`, or `api:<name>`.

deviceIds.title: device_ids
deviceIds.description: The devices the target resolved to when the run started.

iteration.title: iteration
iteration.description: The repetition in progress, counting from one.

steps.title: steps
steps.description: The steps of the repetition in progress.

scheduleId.title: schedule_id
scheduleId.description: Set when a schedule started the run.

detail.title: detail
detail.description: Why the run could not start or why it stopped early.

target.title: target
target.description: What the run was asked to do, so it can be run again the same way.

operator.title: operator
operator.description: Who started the run; a scheduled run acts as the schedule's owner.

yunheshiguang.automation.v1.FlowRunResul.title: FlowRunResult
yunheshiguang.automation.v1.FlowRunResul.description: Whether a run started; refused runs carry the reason in `detail`.

yunheshiguang.automation.v1.FlowRuns.title: FlowRuns
yunheshiguang.automation.v1.FlowRuns.description: Runs in progress and the recent history, newest first.

value.title: value
value.description: The one value the action takes: text, package name, path, or script id.

repeat.title: repeat
repeat.description: How many times the flow runs back to back; zero and one both mean once.

retryAttempts.title: retry_attempts
retryAttempts.description: How many more times a failed step is tried before the run stops.

retryDelaySeconds.title: retry_delay_seconds
retryDelaySeconds.description: Pause before trying a failed step again.

yunheshiguang.automation.v1.RunTarget.title: RunTarget
yunheshiguang.automation.v1.RunTarget.description:
Which devices a run goes to. Groups and tags are resolved when the run
 starts, against the devices connected at that moment.

id.title: id
id.description: Letters, digits, `-` and `_`; a UUID fits.

cron.title: cron
cron.description: A five-field cron expression in local time, for example `0 9 * * 1-5`.

owner.title: owner
owner.description:
Who saved the schedule. Its runs are authorized and audited as this
 operator; the backend sets it when the schedule is saved.

yunheshiguang.automation.v1.Schedule.title: Schedule
yunheshiguang.automation.v1.Schedule.description:
Run a flow on a target at the times a cron expression names. Schedules
 belong to the computer the devices are attached to, so they are stored
 with the app's local data rather than in the synced document store.

nextRunAt.title: next_run_at
nextRunAt.description: Unset when the schedule is disabled or its cron expression is invalid.

problem.title: problem
problem.description: Why the schedule cannot fire, such as an invalid cron expression.

attempts.title: attempts
attempts.description: Attempts made so far, retries included.

result.title: result
result.description: What each device's last attempt returned.

endpoint.title: endpoint
endpoint.description: Where adb reaches it; unset while the provider has no address for it.

yunheshiguang.cloud.v1.CloudPhoneRequest.title: CloudPhoneRequest
yunheshiguang.cloud.v1.CloudPhoneRequest.description: Start, stop, or remove one phone.

providers.title: providers
providers.description: Contributed providers first, then the core's.

yunheshiguang.cloud.v1.CloudPhonesChange.title: CloudPhonesChanged
yunheshiguang.cloud.v1.CloudPhonesChange.description:
Payload of `workspace:cloud-phones-changed`, sent after a phone was started,
 stopped, registered, or removed.

yunheshiguang.cloud.v1.CloudProviderInfo.title: CloudProviderInfo
yunheshiguang.cloud.v1.CloudProviderInfo.description:
One source of cloud phones: the core's phones registered by address, or a
 vendor an extension connects to.

yunheshiguang.cloud.v1.ProviderProblem.title: ProviderProblem
yunheshiguang.cloud.v1.ProviderProblem.description: A provider that could not list its phones, and why.

yunheshiguang.connection.v1.ConnectDevic.title: ConnectDeviceRequest
yunheshiguang.connection.v1.ConnectDevic.description:
Attaches a device that already listens for debugging connections, for example
 after `adb tcpip` or once wireless debugging has been paired.

deviceId.title: device_id
deviceId.description: Identifier the device carries once attached, or the one that was detached.

yunheshiguang.connection.v1.DisconnectDe.title: DisconnectDeviceRequest
yunheshiguang.connection.v1.DisconnectDe.description:
Detaches one network device. `device_id` is the `host:port` identifier the
 device carries in the workspace snapshot.

transportId.title: transport_id
transportId.description:
Id of the transport that found it; the connection plan with the same id
 explains that transport.

label.title: label
label.description:
What the transport calls the device. Service names carry the device
 serial, so this is searchable text with its own privacy class.

requiresPairing.title: requires_pairing
requiresPairing.description:
The endpoint is a pairing service: pair with the code the device shows
 before connecting.

yunheshiguang.connection.v1.DiscoveredEn.title: DiscoveredEndpoint
yunheshiguang.connection.v1.DiscoveredEn.description:
A device a transport can reach but that is not attached yet, for example a
 phone advertising Android wireless debugging over mDNS, or a cloud phone from
 an extension's inventory.

yunheshiguang.connection.v1.DiscoveryFai.title: DiscoveryFailure
yunheshiguang.connection.v1.DiscoveryFai.description:
A transport whose discovery failed. The other transports still report
 their devices.

yunheshiguang.connection.v1.NetworkEndpo.title: NetworkEndpoint
yunheshiguang.connection.v1.NetworkEndpo.description: Where a network device listens. `host` is an IPv4 or IPv6 literal or a host name.

yunheshiguang.connection.v1.PairDeviceRe.title: PairDeviceRequest
yunheshiguang.connection.v1.PairDeviceRe.description:
Pairs with a device through Android 11+ wireless debugging. The endpoint and
 code are the ones the device shows under "Pair device with pairing code".

yunheshiguang.documents.v1.Document.title: Document
yunheshiguang.documents.v1.Document.description:
A JSON document owned by the frontend, such as one automation flow. The store
 only guarantees the body is valid JSON; its shape belongs to whoever writes it.

yunheshiguang.documents.v1.DocumentsChan.title: DocumentsChanged
yunheshiguang.documents.v1.DocumentsChan.description:
Payload of the `workspace:documents-changed` event, sent after a save or a
 removal so every window refreshes that collection.

actor.title: actor
actor.description:
Through what the operation came: a window label, `schedule:<name>`, or
 `api:<caller>`.

targets.title: targets
targets.description: Devices or endpoints the operation touched, masked the way the run log masks them.

groups.title: groups
groups.description: Groups of the target devices; ungrouped devices count as `ungrouped`.

yunheshiguang.governance.v1.AuditEntry.title: AuditEntry
yunheshiguang.governance.v1.AuditEntry.description: One governed operation as the audit trail remembers it.

nextBeforeId.title: next_before_id
nextBeforeId.description: Pass as `before_id` to read the next page; empty on the last page.

problem.title: problem
problem.description: Set when the audit store could not be read; `entries` is empty then.

actor.title: actor
actor.description:
An exact actor, or a channel such as `api` or `schedule` that matches every
 actor with that prefix.

beforeId.title: before_id
beforeId.description: Only entries older than this entry, for reading the next page.

limit.title: limit
limit.description: At most this many entries; zero means the store's page size.

yunheshiguang.governance.v1.AuditQuery.title: AuditQuery
yunheshiguang.governance.v1.AuditQuery.description: Filters for the audit history. An empty field matches everything.

truncated.title: truncated
truncated.description: The count stopped at the store's retention limit; older entries are left out.

problem.title: problem
problem.description: Set when the audit store could not be read.

yunheshiguang.governance.v1.AuditReport.title: AuditReport
yunheshiguang.governance.v1.AuditReport.description: Totals over the audit history, by operator, device group, action, and day.

key.title: key
key.description:
An operator id, a device group id (`ungrouped` for devices in none), an
 action such as `GOVERNED_ACTION_RUN_BATCH_ACTION`, or a day as `YYYY-MM-DD`
 in the caller's time zone.

label.title: label
label.description: A readable name when the key is not one, such as an operator's name.

yunheshiguang.governance.v1.AuditTally.title: AuditTally
yunheshiguang.governance.v1.AuditTally.description: One row of an audit report: what was counted and how it went.

path.title: path
path.description: Where to write the file, chosen by the operator in a save dialog.

yunheshiguang.governance.v1.GovernancePr.title: GovernanceProvider
yunheshiguang.governance.v1.GovernancePr.description:
Names the implementation installed behind one governance contract, so the
 governance page can say which policy is in force.

grantedCapabilities.title: granted_capabilities
grantedCapabilities.description:
Capability keys granted to this build. A workspace module that requires a
 capability only mounts once the key is granted.

auditTrail.title: audit_trail
auditTrail.description: Most recent first, at most `audit_capacity` entries.

license.title: license
license.description: Absent when no license is installed.

identity.title: identity
identity.description: Who the operator of this computer's windows is, and who says so.

auditStore.title: audit_store
auditStore.description: Where the audit history is kept and queried.

yunheshiguang.governance.v1.GovernedActi.title: GovernedAction
yunheshiguang.governance.v1.GovernedActi.description:
An operation that changes devices or the host toolchain. Governance authorizes
 it before it runs and audits it afterwards. Append new values; never renumber.

licensee.title: licensee
licensee.description: Who the license is issued to, as the entitlement provider shows it.

yunheshiguang.governance.v1.License.title: License
yunheshiguang.governance.v1.License.description:
The license or subscription behind the granted capabilities: the billing side
 of entitlements. The open-source core has none.

roles.title: roles
roles.description: Roles an authorization policy grants permissions to.

yunheshiguang.governance.v1.Operator.title: Operator
yunheshiguang.governance.v1.Operator.description:
Who performed an operation: the person using this computer, a team member an
 identity provider recognized, or a local API caller.

query.title: query
query.description: Which entries to count; `before_id` and `limit` are ignored.

utcOffsetMinutes.title: utc_offset_minutes
utcOffsetMinutes.description: Minutes east of UTC at which days start, such as 480 for UTC+8.

setup.title: setup
setup.description:
What to do on a device before this channel can serve it, in order. Empty
 when the channel needs nothing on the device.

yunheshiguang.input.v1.InputChannelInfo.title: InputChannelInfo
yunheshiguang.input.v1.InputChannelInfo.description:
One way of getting text onto devices, such as a helper pushed to the device
 or an input method installed on it.

yunheshiguang.input.v1.InputChannels.title: InputChannels
yunheshiguang.input.v1.InputChannels.description:
The installed channels in the order they are asked: for each device, the
 first channel that takes a request delivers it.

yunheshiguang.input.v1.InputKind.title: InputKind
yunheshiguang.input.v1.InputKind.description: What an input channel can put on a device.

yunheshiguang.packages.v1.ConflictPolicy.title: ConflictPolicy
yunheshiguang.packages.v1.ConflictPolicy.description: What to do with an item whose id is already in the library.

flowIds.title: flow_ids
flowIds.description: The flows to include; the scripts they run are included with them.

path.title: path
path.description: Where to write the file, chosen in a save dialog.

yunheshiguang.packages.v1.MarketRef.title: MarketRef
yunheshiguang.packages.v1.MarketRef.description: A package offered by a template source that the granted capabilities unlock.

yunheshiguang.packages.v1.PackageItem.title: PackageItem
yunheshiguang.packages.v1.PackageItem.description:
A flow or script in a package, and whether the library already has one with
 the same id.

version.title: version
version.description: Semantic version of the package's content, for example `1.2.0`.

yunheshiguang.packages.v1.PackageManifes.title: PackageManifest
yunheshiguang.packages.v1.PackageManifes.description: Describes a package of flows and the scripts they run.

json.title: json
json.description:
The package document itself, for callers that have no file on this
 computer, such as the local API.

path.title: path
path.description: A package file chosen by the operator.

yunheshiguang.packages.v1.PackageOrigin.title: PackageOrigin
yunheshiguang.packages.v1.PackageOrigin.description: Where a package to inspect or install comes from.

problems.title: problems
problems.description:
What would make the installed flows fail, such as a step that runs a
 script the package does not include.

verified.title: verified
verified.description:
Signed by this computer's key or a key the operator trusts, or offered by a
 template source built into this application.

signer.title: signer
signer.description: Set when the package is signed and its signature checks out.

publicKey.title: public_key
publicKey.description: The signer's minisign public key, base64.

yunheshiguang.packages.v1.PackageSignatu.title: PackageSignature
yunheshiguang.packages.v1.PackageSignatu.description:
A minisign signature over the package's JSON without `digest` and
 `signature`, keys sorted and no whitespace. The digest only shows that the
 file is unchanged; the signature shows whose key published it. The signer's
 name is in the signed trusted comment (`signer:<name>`).

keyId.title: key_id
keyId.description: The minisign key id, 16 uppercase hex digits.

name.title: name
name.description:
The name the operator trusted the key under, or, for a key not yet
 trusted, the name the signer signed with.

trusted.title: trusted
trusted.description: This computer's own key, or a key the operator chose to trust.

publicKey.title: public_key
publicKey.description: The signer's minisign public key, base64, for trusting it.

yunheshiguang.packages.v1.PackageSigner.title: PackageSigner
yunheshiguang.packages.v1.PackageSigner.description: A signer whose signature checked out.

digest.title: digest
digest.description:
Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the package file's JSON without this field, with
 object keys sorted and no whitespace. Fields a newer version adds are
 covered too, so older readers can still verify the file.

signature.title: signature
signature.description: Who published the package, when it is signed.

yunheshiguang.packages.v1.TemplatePackag.title: TemplatePackage
yunheshiguang.packages.v1.TemplatePackag.description:
A shareable bundle of flows and the scripts they run. A package file is this
 message as JSON.

name.title: name
name.description: How this computer refers to the signer; the signed name when empty.

yunheshiguang.packages.v1.TrustPackageSi.title: TrustPackageSignerRequest
yunheshiguang.packages.v1.TrustPackageSi.description: Trust a signer, so the packages it signs show as trusted.

id.title: id
id.description: Letters, digits, `-` and `_`; a UUID fits.

yunheshiguang.profiles.v1.DeviceGroupDef.title: DeviceGroupDefinition
yunheshiguang.profiles.v1.DeviceGroupDef.description:
A group the operator created. Each group is one document in the
 `device-groups` collection.

deviceKey.title: device_key
deviceKey.description:
The hardware serial (`ro.serialno`) when the device reports a unique one,
 otherwise its adb serial. The hardware serial stays the same over USB and
 over the network, so the profile follows the device between them.

number.title: number
number.description: Zero when no number is assigned.

groupId.title: group_id
groupId.description:
Empty when the device is in no group. A group that no longer exists counts
 as no group.

yunheshiguang.profiles.v1.DeviceProfile.title: DeviceProfile
yunheshiguang.profiles.v1.DeviceProfile.description:
What the operator wrote down about one device. Each profile is one document
 in the `device-profiles` collection, so a sync-folder or remote document
 store carries profiles between machines like any other document.

number.title: number
number.description:
The first device gets this number and each following device the next
 one. Zero clears the number.

groupId.title: group_id
groupId.description: Empty takes the devices out of every group.

yunheshiguang.profiles.v1.DeviceProfileP.title: DeviceProfilePatch
yunheshiguang.profiles.v1.DeviceProfileP.description: Changes applied to every listed device. Unset fields keep their value.

yunheshiguang.profiles.v1.DeviceProfiles.title: DeviceProfilesChanged
yunheshiguang.profiles.v1.DeviceProfiles.description:
Payload of the `workspace:device-profiles-changed` event, sent after a
 profile or group changes so every window reads the snapshot again.

detail.title: detail
detail.description: Why the change was refused or failed. Unset when it was made.

yunheshiguang.profiles.v1.OrganizeResult.title: OrganizeResult
yunheshiguang.profiles.v1.OrganizeResult.description: Whether a change to profiles or groups was made.

group.title: group
group.description: Created when the id is new, replaced otherwise.

deviceIds.title: device_ids
deviceIds.description: Device ids from the snapshot, in the order numbers are assigned.

yunheshiguang.scripts.v1.Script.title: Script
yunheshiguang.scripts.v1.Script.description:
A script in the library. Each script is one document in the `scripts`
 collection: the frontend writes it, and the backend reads it when a batch
 action or a flow step runs it.

capturesOutput.title: captures_output
capturesOutput.description:
Whether the engine returns what the script printed and its exit code.
 Engines that only launch the script on the device return right away.

setup.title: setup
setup.description: What to do on a device before this engine can serve it, in order.

yunheshiguang.scripts.v1.ScriptEngineInf.title: ScriptEngineInfo
yunheshiguang.scripts.v1.ScriptEngineInf.description: One way of running scripts on devices.

yunheshiguang.scripts.v1.ScriptEngines.title: ScriptEngines
yunheshiguang.scripts.v1.ScriptEngines.description:
The installed engines in the order they are asked: for each device, the
 first engine that takes the script runs it.

batchAction.title: batch_action
batchAction.description: Which batch action, for batch runs; unspecified for every other operation.

yunheshiguang.telemetry.v1.OperationHeal.title: OperationHealth
yunheshiguang.telemetry.v1.OperationHeal.description: How one kind of governed operation has gone since the app started.

yunheshiguang.telemetry.v1.ProbeHealth.title: ProbeHealth
yunheshiguang.telemetry.v1.ProbeHealth.description: One pass over the devices the host can see.

yunheshiguang.telemetry.v1.TelemetrySink.title: TelemetrySinkInfo
yunheshiguang.telemetry.v1.TelemetrySink.description: Where telemetry goes, so the health page can say who else receives it.

sourceId.title: source_id
sourceId.description: Identifier of the source that offers this template.

yunheshiguang.templates.v1.FlowTemplate.title: FlowTemplate
yunheshiguang.templates.v1.FlowTemplate.description: A reusable automation flow blueprint offered by a template source.

yunheshiguang.templates.v1.FlowTemplateC.title: FlowTemplateCatalog
yunheshiguang.templates.v1.FlowTemplateC.description: Every template the current entitlements unlock, grouped by source.

yunheshiguang.templates.v1.TemplateSourc.title: TemplateSourceInfo
yunheshiguang.templates.v1.TemplateSourc.description: Names a template source, such as the built-in starter set or a template market.

yunheshiguang.templates.v1.TemplateStep.title: TemplateStep
yunheshiguang.templates.v1.TemplateStep.description:
One step of a template: a batch action and the single value it takes, which
 may be left empty for the user to fill in.

id.title: id
id.description: The commit for nightly builds, the tag for releases.

downloadUrl.title: download_url
downloadUrl.description: The file that matches how this copy was installed; empty when none does.

channel.title: channel
channel.description: `nightly` or `release`; empty for a local build.

commit.title: commit
commit.description: The full commit the build was made from; empty for a local build.

repository.title: repository
repository.description: The GitHub repository, as `owner/name`, that publishes its releases.

yunheshiguang.updates.v1.BuildInfo.title: BuildInfo
yunheshiguang.updates.v1.BuildInfo.description: What this copy of the app is.

yunheshiguang.updates.v1.UpdateAvailable.title: UpdateAvailable
yunheshiguang.updates.v1.UpdateAvailable.description: Sent with `workspace:update-available` when a scheduled check finds a new build.

detail.title: detail
detail.description: Why the setting was not saved.

yunheshiguang.vendors.v1.DeviceVendor.title: DeviceVendor
yunheshiguang.vendors.v1.DeviceVendor.description: Which adapter recognized a device. Devices no adapter recognizes are left out.

vendors.title: vendors
vendors.description: Profiles of the vendors that recognized at least one of the devices.

guidance.title: guidance
guidance.description: What to set on a device of this vendor before debugging it, in order.

yunheshiguang.vendors.v1.VendorProfile.title: VendorProfile
yunheshiguang.vendors.v1.VendorProfile.description:
A vendor adapter's advice for the devices it recognizes: the switches a
 brand hides in developer options, or the conventions of a board farm.

install.title: install
install.description: The installation currently selected as the rollback-safe private runtime.

lastInstallAttempt.title: last_install_attempt
lastInstallAttempt.description: The latest install attempt, which may have failed while `install` remains usable.

scriptId.title: script_id
scriptId.description: The script document to run, for `BATCH_ACTION_KIND_RUN_SCRIPT`.

deviceHints.title: device_hints
deviceHints.description: Explanations a vendor adapter gave for devices that failed.

inputRoutes.title: input_routes
inputRoutes.description: For text and clipboard actions: which input channel served each device.

scriptOutputs.title: script_outputs

vendorId.title: vendor_id
vendorId.description: Id of the vendor adapter that recognized the device.

yunheshiguang.workspace.v1.DeviceHint.title: DeviceHint
yunheshiguang.workspace.v1.DeviceHint.description:
Why an action failed on one device, in terms of that device's vendor, for
 example a switch the brand hides in developer options.

channelId.title: channel_id
channelId.description:
Id of the input channel; empty when no installed channel could serve the
 device.

failure.title: failure
failure.description: Unset when the channel delivered the text.

yunheshiguang.workspace.v1.DeviceInputRo.title: DeviceInputRoute
yunheshiguang.workspace.v1.DeviceInputRo.description: The input channel that served one device, and why it failed if it did.

number.title: number
number.description: Zero when no number is assigned.

alias.title: alias
alias.description:
The operator's name for the device. It stands in for the masked serial,
 so it is not treated as personal data.

note.title: note
note.description: Free text that may carry personal data, masked like other sensitive fields.

yunheshiguang.workspace.v1.DeviceLabels.title: DeviceLabels
yunheshiguang.workspace.v1.DeviceLabels.description:
The operator's own labels for a device, kept in its profile so they follow
 the device across USB and network connections.

labels.title: labels
labels.description: What the operator wrote down about the device. Unset when it has no profile.

engineId.title: engine_id
engineId.description: Id of the script engine; empty when no installed engine could run it.

exitCode.title: exit_code
exitCode.description: Unset when the engine only launches the script and cannot wait for it.

output.title: output
output.description: What the script printed, stdout and stderr together, cut to a size limit.

failure.title: failure
failure.description: Unset when the engine ran the script.

yunheshiguang.workspace.v1.DeviceScriptO.title: DeviceScriptOutput
yunheshiguang.workspace.v1.DeviceScriptO.description: A script's run on one device.

yunheshiguang.workspace.v1.DevicesChange.title: DevicesChanged
yunheshiguang.workspace.v1.DevicesChange.description:
Payload of the `workspace:devices-changed` event, sent when the ADB server
 reports that a device was attached, detached, or changed state.

yunheshiguang.workspace.v1.PhraseTemplat.title: PhraseTemplate
yunheshiguang.workspace.v1.PhraseTemplat.description:
Never filled in. The phrase library is a document collection owned by the
 frontend, so phrases are not part of the snapshot.

canonicalValue.title: canonical_value
canonicalValue.description: The raw value normalized for matching.

aliases.title: aliases
aliases.description: Additional match terms, as sensitive as the raw value.

redactedValue.title: redacted_value
redactedValue.description: A masked form that is always safe to display and index.

yunheshiguang.workspace.v1.SearchableTex.title: SearchableText
yunheshiguang.workspace.v1.SearchableTex.description:
A value that can be displayed and searched without leaking what it masks.

 Unless `pii_class` is PII_CLASS_NONE, `display_value`, `canonical_value`, and
 `aliases` are all sensitive. While the operator has not revealed sensitive
 data, clients may display and index only `redacted_value`.

yunheshiguang.workspace.v1.WorkspaceScop.title: WorkspaceScope
yunheshiguang.workspace.v1.WorkspaceScop.description:
Ignored. The backend identifies the calling window, or the local API token,
 by itself.
